snippet.title: The Willowmist Emporium of Antiques & Curiosities Animated Opening
snippet.description:
This town is full of people who don't fit in...🌿

The demo for The Willowmist Emporium of Antiques & Curiosities is out NOW on Steam!

Play through the first week of the game, get to know five love interests, and learn the basics of running your very own antique store!

Opening song: Mizu
Animation: Momon

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3477910/The_Willowmist_Emporium_of_Antiques__Curiosities/
Itch: https://twoandahalfstudios.itch.io/willowmist
